title: Recursive Eight-Way Refinement
negative_results: encode_path refuses a negative depth and a depth beyond MAX_REFINEMENT_DEPTH
path_cell refuses an octal digit outside 0..7
a depth-0 path decodes back to the whole face triangle

claims.statement: encode_path maps a direction to (face, octal path) by descending the reused one-to-eight refinement; the path is a tuple of octal digits 0..7 of the requested depth, and a depth-12 path packs into exactly 36 bits (the CW-PACK40-1 path field).

The forward map is deterministic and stable, and path_cell decodes the path back to the spherical cell it names; the decoded cell contains the original direction (barycentric coordinates non-negative within tolerance).
Face selection and child location use a scale-invariant barycentric so descent stays exact at CW-PACK40 depth; deeper than the reused construction's numerical floor is a clean refusal.
An octal path is a cell selector in a synthetic tessellation, not a place. SOURCE_VECTOR_GEOGRAPHIC_SEMANTICS_NOT_CLAIMED; PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic fixtures only, no private inputs
